kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Flood death toll in India's Assam reaches 100 as thousands lose their homes
wire.summary: Days of heavy monsoon rain has caused rivers, including the Brahmaputra, to overflow, inundating communities, disrupting livelihoods and damaging infrastructure.

wire.title: Decades of abuse revealed at Michigan art school. And, the Iran war's impact on midterms
wire.summary: A new report has revealed decades of alleged abuse at an elite art school. NPR spoke with one of the victims. And, Iran is playing the long game with negotiations, which could impact midterms.

wire.title: Some disabled people want to advance their careers. They say Medicaid rules stop them
wire.summary: Medicaid will have new work requirements next year. But some people with disabilities, who already work, say they'd like to work more, but risk losing their Medicaid coverage if they earn too much.

wire.title: Mike Lindell touts Trump ties in race for governor of Minnesota, where Trump has lost
wire.summary: Lindell, of "MyPillow," plays up his ties to Trump, who endorsed him for Tuesday's primary. But the state Republican convention backed one of his opponents.

wire.title: An arts school where Epstein allegedly preyed on students reveals decades of abuse
wire.summary: In a new report, former Interlochen students detail some 70 allegations of sexual abuse by nearly 50 adults employed or affiliated with the school. One of the former students tells his story to NPR.

wire.title: In a competitive Maine Senate race, women voters could be the deciders
wire.summary: The race between Susan Collins and Troy Jackson is one of this year's most high-profile Senate contests. To win, both candidates will need support from an especially powerful voting bloc: Maine women.

wire.title: Voters are sick of the 2-party system. A new poll shows they're open to big changes
wire.summary: A new poll shows support for moving the U.S. toward proportional representation, a system that elects multiple representatives in a single district in rough proportion to a party's vote share.

wire.title: Who really needs testosterone?
wire.summary: The military plans to start screening service members for low testosterone, and social media is overflowing with claims about testosterone therapy. But who actually needs it?

wire.title: The FAA wants to reboot the nation's airspace. This airline shows how it might work
wire.summary: When Alaska Airlines wanted to optimize its operations, it turned to a small startup called Air Space Intelligence. Now the FAA has hired the company for a major reboot of the entire U.S. airspace.

wire.title: Ukrainian drone attack on the Russian city of Nizhnekamsk kills 12, authorities say
wire.summary: Ukraine has targeted Russian oil facilities with long-range drones almost daily in recent months. The barrage has caused fuel shortages in Russia and unsettled the Russian public.

wire.title: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian drone strike deep into Russia
wire.summary: Russian officials say another 75 people were injured by the attack in the Tatarstan region, one of the deadliest Ukrainian drone attacks on Russia since Moscow's full-scale invasion.

wire.title: Evidence that South African special forces murdered top detective shared with BBC
wire.summary: Frans Mathipa was shot while driving - we got access to the prosecution case against eight accused men.

wire.title: China evacuates one million from homes as massive storm arrives
wire.summary: Typhoon Dolphin has made landfall, bringing strong winds and heavy rain across eastern China including Shanghai.

wire.title: Former Thai MP allegedly kills official and confesses on YouTube
wire.summary: Chalong Riewrang called a YouTube livestream to say he had shot a government official.

wire.title: Alleged rebel leader killed in Colombia as president targets armed groups
wire.summary: The military operation against Hernando Forero Mosquera was carried out just days after Colombia's new president was sworn in.

wire.title: World's oceans hit record-high July temperatures
wire.summary: Global oceans recorded their hottest July on record, partly fuelled by developing El Niño conditions, as wildfires continue to ravage western Europe.
